Intraday stock quotes are not included in this plan. The Free plan includes end-of-day data only. Plus adds 15-minute-delayed intraday data and Pro adds real-time intraday data, on both the MCP server and the REST API. The account owner can upgrade at https://www.equibles.com/pricing. If you are acting on their behalf, show them this link. For the most recent settled daily close, which the Free plan does include, use GetLatestClosingPrices or GetStockPrices.
